entries.title: Narrator: "The loud whistle of the ship's depa..."
entries.dialogueText:
The loud whistle of the ship's departure pulled you out of your thoughts.

You went upstairs to the upper deck to watch what used to be your home slowly disappear on the horizon.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...vowed to yourself that you would..."
entries.dialogueText: ...vowed to yourself that you would be back no matter what.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "A new beginning was just around the..."
entries.dialogueText: A new beginning was just around the corner.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...grieved the loss of your positio..."
entries.dialogueText: ...grieved the loss of your position and power.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...decided to look ahead to your fu..."
entries.dialogueText: ...decided to look ahead to your future instead of the past.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The captain came to the upper deck..."
entries.dialogueText:
The captain came to the upper deck to pull down the Rizian flag and replace it with that of Kyrute.

You had entered Kyrutian waters.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "It was a new beginning."
entries.dialogueText: It was a new beginning.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You docked on the island, where an..."
entries.dialogueText:
You docked on the island, where an extraordinary mansion with multiple servants awaited you.

They unpacked your belongings. You went out to the balcony and took in the view.

You thought...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...maybe this was not going to be s..."
entries.dialogueText: ...maybe this was not going to be so bad after all.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...nothing could fill the hole left..."
entries.dialogueText: ...nothing could fill the hole left in your heart.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...you should take it easy for a wh..."
entries.dialogueText: ...you should take it easy for a while.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The captain came to the upper deck..."
entries.dialogueText:
The captain came to the upper deck to pull down the Rizian flag and replace it with that of the Kingdom of Rumburg.

You had entered Rumburgian waters.

For the first time in your life, your noble status didn't grant you any special privileges. However, thanks to your mother transferring some of your wealth, you could afford to live in the same luxury as you once did.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...enjoyed your newfound leisure ti..."

entries.dialogueText:
You received a call from Vina. She had been trying to reach out to you for days.

Though Rizia and Pales were now unified, Duke Axel had managed to make a deal with the new government. Pales was able to maintain some degree of autonomy, and your family could take refuge there.

As the Duchess, Vina invited you to come live with her. You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...agreed and moved to Pales with y..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText:

Axel and Vina did their best to ensure your safe arrival and even gave you a luxurious estate by the Palesian coast. After everything that had happened, you were finally together with your family.

entries.dialogueText:
Over the next years, you settled into your new role as a member of the Rumburgian gentry.

You had access to almost everything money could buy. You enjoyed special privileges due to your family ties to Beatrice and your status as the former King of Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Over the next few years, you became..."
entries.dialogueText:
Over the next few years, you became deeply embedded in Rumburgian court politics. While hesitant at first, Beatrice soon grew to rely on your counsel and assistance.

One day, she assigned you a critical job to crush the democratic opposition in the city of Glenhill, which had become a bastion of the Rumburgian anti-monarchist movement. She offered you the Duchy if you succeed.

You...

Over the next months, you became deeply embedded in Rumburgian court politics. While hesitant at first, Beatrice soon grew to rely on your counsel and assistance.

She told you about her plans of "the Grand Awakening." The long-awaited war with Sordland was about to begin.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Rumburg's army was ready."

entries.dialogueText: Over the next several months, the relationship between Sordland and Rumburg deteriorated drastically. The Rumburgian army was deployed to the southern border.

Your new life of leisure took some getting used to. You were grateful that you could at least enjoy the same luxury you had back in Rizia.

entries.dialogueText: ...founded a company focused on trading Rizian goods.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...joined the Wruhecist Sanctuary o..."
entries.dialogueText: ...joined the Wruhecist Sanctuary of Konstantium.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...tried your luck showcasing your..."
entries.dialogueText: ...tried your luck showcasing your comedy skills in Kyrutean cabarets.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...sold the jewelry and family heir..."
entries.dialogueText: ...sold the jewelry and family heirlooms you'd managed to bring over.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Fuelled by your massive donations,..."
entries.dialogueText:
Fuelled by your massive donations, the Romas Toras Association started to gain traction in Konstantium. 

You were lauded as a humanitarian and invited to join the innermost circles of the Kyrutian elite.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You used your money and connections..."
entries.dialogueText:
You used your money and connections to import Rizian goods to Kyrute. 

After your initial successes, your business started to gain traction in Konstantium. You were welcomed into the innermost circles of the Kyrutean elite.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Kyrutean elite regarded you wit..."
entries.dialogueText: The Kyrutean elite regarded you with suspicion at first. But before long, you began receiving invitations to charity galas and other elite events.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You leveraged your experience as a..."
entries.dialogueText:
You leveraged your experience as a monarch to become a special consultant to the AN, 

You quickly commanded respect among local politicians and diplomats, and were invited to join the innermost circles of the Kyrutian elite.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You tried to use your name and conn..."
entries.dialogueText:
You tried to use your name and connections to increase your media presence.

However, other than being invited to a debate program on a local TV channel, you didn't get many opportunities.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You sold whatever valuable items yo..."
entries.dialogueText: You sold whatever valuable items you could find. You earned a few million, enough to keep you afloat for some time.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You gave yourself to God and joined..."
entries.dialogueText: You gave yourself to God and joined the Sanctuary in Konstantium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once the novelty of a king telling..."
entries.dialogueText:
Once the novelty of a king telling jokes wore off, the Kyrutean cultural elite began to respect you as a skilled comedian.

You gained popularity in Konstantium and even appeared on a few late-night shows.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Not long after your arrival, Lucita..."
entries.dialogueText:
Not long after your arrival, Lucita gave birth to your son, {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}.

For the second time, you were a father.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Long live the new prince of Rizia."
entries.dialogueText: Long live the new prince of Rizia.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "There wasn't much to complain about..."
entries.dialogueText: There wasn't much to complain about.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your new life of leisure took some..."
entries.dialogueText: Your new life of leisure took some getting used to. You were grateful that you could at least enjoy the same luxury you had back in Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Queen grew distant with you aft..."
entries.dialogueText:
The Queen grew distant with you after that. 

You received fewer and fewer invitations to official Palace functions, though your status as the former King of Rizia meant you were still a sought-after member of the Rumburgian gentry. You had access to almost everything money could buy.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You never returned to Rizia."
entries.dialogueText: You never returned to Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The eight years you spent as a mona..."
entries.dialogueText:
The eight years you spent as a monarch faded in your memory, replaced by new adventures and challenges. 

You found yourself answering to "Duke Toras" just as easily as you once answered to "Your Majesty".

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You never returned to Rizia."
entries.dialogueText: You never returned to Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You instituted a successful purge o..."
entries.dialogueText:
You instituted a successful purge of the city's leadership, breaking up the unrest and earning you the title of the Duke of Glenhill.

The Queen hailed you as a hero.

Over the next years, you...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rumburg made swift gains at the beg..."
entries.dialogueText:
Rumburg made swift gains at the beginning of the war. But as soon as the news arrived that the Contanan Security Pact would be coming to Sordland's defense, the atmosphere became bleak.

The Queen banned everyone from leaving Thornbourgh and made criticizing the war a criminal offense. She was now thinking about deploying nuclear weapons.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When the war began, Rumburg made sw..."
entries.dialogueText:
When the war began, Rumburg made swift gains. The Sordish Armed Forces was barely even putting up a fight.

The atmosphere in Thornborough was cheerful and celebratory. You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...tried to stop her."
entries.dialogueText: ...tried to stop her.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...asked her to sue for peace."
entries.dialogueText: ...asked her to sue for peace.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...wholeheartedly prayed for her su..."
entries.dialogueText: ...wholeheartedly prayed for her success.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rumburg's military made swift gains..."
entries.dialogueText:
Rumburg's military made swift gains at the beginning of the war, but was met with unexpected resistance from the Sordish Armed Forces.

You received news of battles being lost and armies retreating.

Meanwhile, the Queen imposed lockdowns on Rumburg's major cities and made criticizing the war a criminal offense. You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...begged her to find a peaceful so..."
entries.dialogueText: ...begged her to find a peaceful solution.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...prayed for her success."
entries.dialogueText: ...prayed for her success.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...prayed for minimal casualties on..."
entries.dialogueText: ...prayed for minimal casualties on both sides.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...toasted to victory with the Rumm..."
entries.dialogueText: ...toasted to victory with the Rummish elite.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...did not care."
entries.dialogueText: ...did not care.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The day that the Sordish Armed Forc..."
entries.dialogueText:
The day that the Sordish Armed Forces began their invasion of the Rumburgian mainland, Queen Beatrice authorized the use of one of her secret nuclear missiles.

This would be the first time such a weapon would be used on people.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "And it was fired at Holsord."
entries.dialogueText: And it was fired at Holsord.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the wake of Holsord's destructio..."
entries.dialogueText:
In the wake of Holsord's destruction, the superpowers started deploying their nuclear weapons as well.

Within a couple of hours, all hell broke loose in Thornborough.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Everything ended with a blinding li..."
entries.dialogueText: Everything ended with a blinding light.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "To the surprise of everyone, Sordis..."
entries.dialogueText:
To the surprise of everyone, Sordish forces managed to occupy most of the key southern locations and surround Thornborough.

Meanwhile, the Queen published in the state gazette that every Rumburgian resident was now obliged to take up arms and fight the invading force. Anyone who tried to flee would be shot.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Several months later, Queen Beatric..."
entries.dialogueText:
Several months later, Queen Beatrice announced Rumburg's historic victory over Sordland. She declared that the Sollist threat had been neutralized and that the Sords' victims, the Bludish, would finally be given the right to their own nationhood.

The world watched the developments with concerned silence.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...isolated yourself and waited for..."
entries.dialogueText: ...isolated yourself and waited for the war to end.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...tried to flee Thornborough."
entries.dialogueText: ...tried to flee Thornborough.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...joined the armed resistance."
entries.dialogueText: ...joined the armed resistance.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Time passed."
entries.dialogueText: Time passed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You isolated yourself in your mansi..."
entries.dialogueText:
You isolated yourself in your mansion. When the Sordish Armed Forces entered the city, they started to unleash their vengeance on the Rummish nobility in the capital.

Before long, the soldiers broke down your door and pointed guns at your head. Ordered to arrest anyone connected to the Livingstons, they charged you with death.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On your last days, you planned an e..."
entries.dialogueText:
On your last days, you planned an escape from Thornborough with your family.

However, you were caught at the city's borders by the Queen's soldiers. 

The punishment was clear.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On your last days, you joined the a..."
entries.dialogueText:
On your last days, you joined the armed resistance in Thornborough and were deployed to fight against the incoming Sordish Armed Forces.

You charged at the invaders as a Sordish bullet flew straight towards your head.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "And so it was over."
entries.dialogueText: And so it was over.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...helped Rumburg plan the "Great U..."
entries.dialogueText: ...helped Rumburg plan the "Great Unification."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...advised the Queen to promote pea..."
entries.dialogueText: ...advised the Queen to promote peace.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...assisted the Queen however you c..."
entries.dialogueText: ...assisted the Queen however you could while raising your son.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When you arrived in Rumburg, a prof..."
entries.dialogueText:
When you arrived in Rumburg, a profound feeling of relief and regret washed over you. You wondered if you'd ever be allowed back into Rizia again.

Thanks to Queen Beatrice's kindness, you were given one of the seven palaces of the Livingstons in Thornborough. 

Your mother, Vina and Manus were already there, waiting for you.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few days later your mother, Vina..."
entries.dialogueText:
A few days later your mother, Vina and Pabel made it out of Rizia and joined you in Rumburg. 

They said that your remaining personal assets had been seized before they were allowed to leave.

You had just begun to feel at home in Pales when Lucita gave birth to your son, {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}.

You were a father once again.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: Long live the new prince.

The Queen banned everyone from leaving Thornbourgh and made criticizing the war a criminal offense. She was now thinking about deploying nuclear weapons.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You received a call from Vina. She..."
entries.dialogueText:
You received a call from Vina. She had been trying to reach out to you for days.

Because Pales and Rizia had never fully unified, the Grand Duchy remained autonomous. The Royal Family could take refuge there without fear of extradition.

As the Grand Duchess, Vina invited you to come live with her. You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Several days later, you received th..."
entries.dialogueText:
Several days later, you received the news of Duchess Lucita Azaro's swift government takeover in your absence.

They had declared her the new Queen of Rizia.

entries.dialogueText: One day, you opened your morning paper and saw the headlines. Queen Lucita of Rizia had given birth to an heir, {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}. Your son.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You sent her a letter of congratula..."
entries.dialogueText: You sent her a letter of congratulations.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You begged her to be able to visit..."
entries.dialogueText: You begged her to be able to visit your child.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You ignored the news."
entries.dialogueText: You ignored the news.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your former wife sent her regrets,..."
entries.dialogueText: Your former wife sent her regrets, telling you that she was unable to guarantee your security if you set foot on Rizian soil.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your former wife didn't respond to..."
entries.dialogueText: Your former wife didn't respond to your letter. You had no way of knowing if she even received it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your paternal bliss was interrupted..."
entries.dialogueText:
Your paternal bliss was interrupted by the disturbing news of a nuclear exchange between Rumburg and Sordland.

Rumburgians began fleeing their destroyed hometowns for Rizia. Many of them settled in Pales.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your paternal bliss was interrupted..."
entries.dialogueText:
Your paternal bliss was interrupted by the disturbing news that Rumburg and Sordland were at war.

Rumburgian civilians fled to Rizia, seeking safe haven from the conflict. Many of them settled in Pales.

Manus arrived from Rizia and joyfully reunited with his wife. 

He had done what he could to ease Rizia's government transition. But in the end, family came above all else.

Several days later you received the news of Hugo's coronation in Porte Drazon. Rizia had a new king.

By royal decree, you were permanently barred from the kingdom.
